description: This file defines Express.js routes for session management, including tenant listing, setting active tenant, and toggling super admin mode, with integrated audit logging and RBAC checks.

methods.name: GET /api/session/tenants
methods.description: Returns list of tenants for authenticated user with audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/session/tenant
methods.description: Sets active tenant in session, with RBAC validation, cookie setting, and audit logging.

methods.name: POST /api/tenants/select
methods.description: Alias for setting active tenant, reusing the /tenant handler.

methods.name: POST /api/session/all-tenants
methods.description: Enables/disables super admin mode for the session, affecting tenant filtering, with audit logging.
